meta.topic: Lot-specific COA — what to ask for before you sign

slides.headline: One document beats a hundred promises.
slides.statOrQuote: "Ask for the lot-specific COA — not the catalogue spec sheet."
slides.body: A catalogue spec sheet describes the product line. A lot-specific COA describes the bag you're actually buying. Request one before you sign.

caption.primaryText: A catalogue spec sheet tells you what the product line is supposed to be. A lot-specific COA tells you what's actually in the bag you're buying. Always ask for the second one before you sign. RM Psyllium provides lot-specific COA support on every sample request — export@rmpsyllium.com.
